description: Checks the federal residence conditions for ordinary Swiss naturalisation (BüG Art. 9, 33) or facilitated naturalisation of a Swiss citizen's spouse (BüG Art. 21) from the years someone has lived in Switzerland: years between ages 8 and 18 count double (at least 6 actual years), temporary admission (F) counts half, C permit required. Returns which conditions are met with the law articles, and what is missing. Cantons add 2 to 5 years of residence in the canton (BüG 18). Orientation only, not legal advice.

years_age_8_to_18.description: of those, years between the 8th and 18th birthday

years_in_last_5.description: of those, years within the last 5 years

years_temporary_admission_f.description: years with temporary admission F (count half)

years_total.description: actual years lived in Switzerland with B, C or Ci permit

name: naturalisation_timing
